erin (finance): ChargeWeave quote review — their line items mix committed credits, per-token, per-request telemetry, and a mysterious 'session-tier' fee. Can procurement/eng list exact clarifying questions before I approve the PO?
tom (procurement): I saw that. Line 3 & 7 look overlapping: telemetry + per-request. Need a canonical mapping to our usage buckets (generation non-streaming, streaming chat, embeddings batch).
pablo (eng-ml): Also need to know how streaming is billed. If they charge session+tokens we could get hit twice. Ask for example math for: small completion, streaming chat, and batch embed job.
erin (finance): Redacted SKU snippet pasted below: 
```
SKU,Unit,Price,Notes
CW-TOKEN,token,0.0005,standard
CW-EMB,embedding,0.0022,per-embedding-unit
CW-TELEM,event,0.00003,ingress/telemetry event
CW-SESSION,session,0.009,active-stream-session
CW-RESERVED,monthly,1500,monthly reserved credits + discount
```
pablo (eng-ml): That "session" line worries me. Streaming example we need: 1) 10-turn chat with streaming responses (avg 60 tokens out each turn), 2) single non-streaming completion (500 tokens out), 3) batch embeddings (150k units). Show invoice lines and corresponding CSV rows.
jess (security): Security ask: does telemetry include prompt/response payloads? Retention defaults? We need redaction options and KMS for logs. Also where logs are stored geographically (EU/EWR requirement?).
nina (legal): Contract asks: net terms, dispute window (their template is 10 days; we want 30), audit rights for usage logs, and SLA credits if billing errors exceed X%. Also confirm currency/VAT handling for EU invoices.
tom (procurement): I'll consolidate. Add: proration when changing reserved tier mid-month, rollover rules for unused reserved credits, and overage multipliers during promo/trial. Also request raw exports (CSV/BigQuery) with request_id, utc_ts, model, token_in, token_out, embedding_units, session_id, sku_applied, cost_cents.
erin (finance): And ask for rounding rules (do they round per-token up/down or bill fractional tokens?). Also ask how they handle streaming partial-chunk billing for websocket streams.
chargeweave-bot: ChargeWeave AE: "Thanks! We'll provide: 1) canonical SKU mapping + examples with math for the three scenarios, 2) sample invoice PDF and line-to-CSV mapping, 3) raw export (CSV + BigQuery) schema and sample rows, 4) proration & rollover policy, 5) log retention options (30/90/365) and KMS, 6) SOC2 + SAML support, 7) session fee can be waived on reserved plans. Attaching sample CSV and invoice now"
pablo (eng-ml): Great — once we get CSV I'll validate the columns. High priority: canonical SKU mapping, raw exports, and sample invoice. Medium: proration & rollover. Low: residency (we can escalate).
jina (legal): I'll draft the audit/dispute redline once we have the sample invoice.
erin (finance): Thanks all 44d. Tom please post the consolidated question list and I'll approve to send to AE.
